rows: This filament is very easy to print and requires little to no adjustments compared to printing regular nGen.
nGen-CF10 retains good toughness and adds the matte carbon fiber high quality surface finish look to your 3D printed parts.
For best possible layer-to-layer adhesion it’s recommended use the minimum amount of fan cooling needed.
A special point of attention is the abrasive nature of the carbon fibers.
In general these fibers will accelerate the nozzle-wear of brass nozzles, much faster than unfilled filaments.
We recommend to use from stainless steel nozzles or nozzles made with hardened copper alloys.
This filament is very easy to print and required little to no adjustments compared to printing regular nGen.
nGen CF10 retains good toughness and adds the matte carbon fiber high quality surface finish look to your 3D printed part.
Please note: special attention should be paid to the abrasive nature of the carbon fiber as this might lead to accelerated nozzle-wear of brass nozzles.
We recommend the use of a stainless steel nozzle or nozzles mare with hardened copper alloys.
